      "observations": [
        "The first-stage consolidation adds a typed numeric junk score with explicit origin/optional percentage to nsMsgDBFolder, and a separate performActionsOnJunkMsgs API that does not mark the score. Extension updates use user origin; filters use filter, plugin and allowlist remain distinct. IMAP override still maps scores to Junk/NonJunk keywords.",
        "Native action selection covers manual read preference, disabled move/delete, junk-folder recovery to Inbox, and trash restrictions. Moving the JS implementation also changes its previous spamSettings.markAsReadOnSpam lookup to the native manual-mark preference; this is not described as a behavior-free relocation. JS awaits junk then good callbacks in order. Empty/no-action branches notify success immediately; actual copy completion is forwarded by CopyServiceListener. Immediate copy/delete returns are not assigned into rv here, so no all-failure-delivery guarantee is claimed.",
        "Full408-line test checks score/origin setter separately; action-only no-op/read/move/delete/reinstate branches deliberately keep empty junkscore. Fixed test is byte-identical to full historical body already read. Review Error rejections are applied; ACString remains, only GetMessageId returns NS_ERROR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED while other adapter stubs return NS_OK, and array-index fixture names remain. All5review rows stillNotDone do not establish universal adoption. Part2is later."
